title: Sheehan as counsel to Disclosure Project, John Mack and Elizondo

tellings.quote: he knew perfectly well that for 20 years I was legal counsel for the disclosure project he knew I represented Dr John Mack he knew that I was at the peer group

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that for about 20 years he was legal counsel for the Disclosure Project, a group pushing the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs. He says he also represented a doctor named John Mack and took part in a peer group, and that a man named Lou Elizondo knew all of this, which he offers as proof of his long place at the center of the subject.
